name: Kinesis Gold
oneLiner: KAU (ERC-20) is KMS Labs' Ethereum gold token backed 1:1 by native Kinesis KAU; physical redemption is two-step and ERC-20 balances do not earn fee yield.
collateral: 1:1 reserves of Kinesis-native KAU held by KMS Labs S.A. (Panama); native KAU is in turn backed 1:1 by allocated physical gold in ABX vaults.
pegMechanism: KMS Labs may offer discretionary 1:1 redemption of ERC-20 KAU for Kinesis-native KAU after compliance onboarding, without guaranteed availability or processing time; physical gold redemption then follows Kinesis Cayman terms. ERC-20 holders have no legal, equitable, or beneficial title to the reserves.

liabilityScope.reason: the feed covers the whole Kinesis Cayman gold balance, and the audited liability basis is Kinesis-native KAU circulation (2,565,133.465 at the 2026-04-20 audit ledger); the registry's Ethereum ERC-20 is a KMS Labs representation backed by native KAU held in reserve, so its totalSupply() is only a subset of the program supply

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The authored Ethereum KAU is a KMS Labs commodity-linked representation backed by native Kinesis KAU. Native KAU's allocated bullion ownership, off-balance-sheet custody, and biannual physical inspections do not extend to the ERC-20 holder: KMS Labs terms expressly deny reserve title and a trust or fiduciary relationship. ERC-20 redemption is discretionary and two-step before physical delivery. The existing commodity-claim archetype is retained without claiming direct bullion title.
